feat(post): the document's program number and comment, per dialect

The program number and program comment (#258 part 2) are a document
field (ProgramInfo, project v59), set through the undoable
SetProgramInfo from the Post page's Program number / Program comment
fields and the MCP tool set_program. The command refuses by name a
number outside 1-9999 and a comment over 40 characters, non-ASCII or
holding ( ) % ; *. The engine hands the script a `program` global
({ number, numbered, comment }, engine::run_program_with).

Each post writes it in its own dialect: Fanuc, Fanuc Lathe and Mazak
O0001-O9999 (past it refused, no longer clamped); Haas a five-digit
O-word only when stated; PathPilot no O-word (flow control on LinuxCNC),
the number in the header comment; Heidenhain the program name
(%NAME G71 *); SINUMERIK %_N_<NAME>_MPF, a name its rules refuse is
refused by name. One file per operation counts up from the stated
number. Nothing stated posts byte-identical (goldens unchanged).

Refs #258

Merge upstream/main into issue/258-program-number (#981 units, #1126 Fanuc Lathe inch)

Keep both sides. Main's #981 took project v60 for the document-unit
law, so #258's `program` key moves to its own rung: PROJECT_VERSION 61,
a v60 -> v61 step that loads with nothing stated (O0001, the machine's
name). An old reader must still refuse a file that states a program.

- project/file.rs: both version notes; PROJECT_VERSION 61; ProgramDto
  doc says v61+.
- project/apply.rs, project/mod.rs: the rung comment and module doc.
- posting.rs, posting_mounts.rs: #258's program module next to #981's
  program_unit module; run_program_with takes program_options(world)
  (the post options plus the document's Units) and the program id.
- fanuc-lathe.cps onOpen: #258's progComment() header with #1126's
  G20/G21 unit word.
- docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md: the Units paragraph, then the program one.
- program_info test: v61 floor; a v60 file steps up with nothing
  stated and no load note. Decision file renumbered to v61.
